author: ivanlitteri
content:
Hey everyone! We've published an experimental comparison of the four proposals for introducing native leanSPHINCS signatures in Hegotá.

We implemented all four in ethrex, both with and without builder-side aggregation, including the corresponding changes in the CL (if applicable, on ethlambda).

We compare implementation complexity, performance, resource pricing, and upgrade paths towards EIP-8288. The results challenge some of our initial assumptions and raise some interesting questions.

We'd love to hear your feedback!

https://ethresear.ch/t/paths-to-post-quantum-execution-in-hegota-an-experimental-comparison/26304
